papers.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints
papers.abstract: Language-model judges now gate training data, score generations, and drive leaderboards. The judge is then a measurement instrument, resting on one rarely stated assumption: the same request, sent to the same model name, reads the same tomorrow. We audited that assumption in two preregistered campaigns with every threshold fixed in advance; neither got past validating its instrument. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04198v1)：两个预注册实验、52,988 audited request attempts 测得 same-window repeat rankings 的 Spearman 0.400，未达作者预设必达阈值，挑战 LLM-as-a-Judge 的稳态假设；与 leaderboard、训练 reward 信号、judge legibility 直接相关。即时可验证性最高。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 核验实验协议与原始数据是否公开。

papers.title: Knowledge Acquisition During Pre-training? Large Language Models Learn Better With Auxiliary Views
papers.abstract: Gaps remain in our understanding of how large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge during pre-training. We posit that auxiliary views, reformulations of knowledge, are causally helpful for learning. We design controlled experiments to isolate this. First, we confirm that repetition is necessary for acquisition and clarify that paraphrasing helps only at smaller batch sizes. Second, holding the token budget fixed, allocating tokens from document repetition to auxiliary views improves learning
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04180v1)：controlled experiments 隔离 repetition 与 auxiliary views 的因果效应；确认 repetition 是 acquisition 必要条件、paraphrasing 仅在小 batch 有效，并在 token budget 固定时证明把 token 从 repetition 重新分配到 auxiliary views 改善 learning。直接回答 pre-training 数据 budget 的分配问题，趋势层资产。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
papers.abstract: Evolutionary prompt optimizers such as GEPA suffer from prompt bloat: each iteration appends rules and caveats, producing prompts up to 3$\times$ longer yet no more accurate. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04197v1)：ESPO 把 evolutionary prompt optimization 从'每轮追加规则 + 3× 长度'推到 Error-Structured Prompt Optimization（Diagnose → Diversify → Stabilize），针对 GEPA prompt bloat 问题。趋势价值明确，与 prompt optimization / context engineering 路线一致。代码/benchmark：暂无，PDF 链接在 arXiv 条目中。

papers.title: Legibility is Not Interpretability: Comparing Judged and Actual Importance in Chain-Of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reasoning traces from chain-of-thought models appear to offer a legible window into how a model arrives at its answer. A growing body of work treats them as such, using LLM judges to diagnose errors, evaluate faithfulness, and provide step-level supervision via process reward models and generative critics. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04194v1)：把 CoT 的 legibility 与 actual functional importance 系统性对比，质疑 process reward model / generative critic 等做法假设的'reasoning step 文本可作为重要性信号'。与 judge 三件套（legibility / reliability / legibility=interpretability）共振。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 核验消融设置。

papers.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
papers.abstract: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable neural function. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04199v1)：提出 compile by training，把自然语言规范 → 任务样本 → 小型 adapter + compact interpreter，使重复文本函数可本地推理，绕开远程 LLM 调用成本/延迟/供应商依赖。属于'agent 本地化执行'方向，与 edge-LLM、speculative decoding、distillation 一脉相承；趋势价值清晰。代码与 benchmark 链接：暂无；论文 PDF 在链接中。

papers.title: Last Translation Benchmark
papers.abstract: For scientific progress, we need benchmarks that test the limits of state-of-the-art models, and evaluation methods that inform us about failure cases. As models get stronger, standard benchmarks for machine translation are approaching saturation. Further, automatic translation metrics are unreliable, vulnerable to reward-hacking, and provide unactionable assessments. Even gold human evaluation is not problem-free, because it often lacks reproducibility, objectivity, and scalability. Overall, th
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04173v1)：把机器翻译评测从'饱和 benchmark + 不可靠自动指标 + 不可扩展人工评测'推到'last benchmark'，同时解决三件事（饱和、reward hacking、不可扩展人工评测）。评测治理趋势价值清晰；与 Last-Eval 类工作同方向。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: One Editor, Many Edits: A Unified Training-Free Framework for Diverse Video Editing
papers.abstract: Video editing spans diverse editing paradigms, yet achieving high-quality instruction-guided and subject-guided editing within a single unified framework remains challenging. We introduce EditVid, a training-free framework combining sparse causal memory for local coherence, correspondence-based post-attention token injection for long-range identity preservation, and soft latent blending for edit locality. The same framework supports instruction-guided and reference-guided edits, including style
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04190v1)：EditVid 是 training-free 视频编辑统一框架，结合 sparse causal memory + correspondence-based post-attention token injection + soft latent blending；同时支持 instruction-guided 与 reference-guided。training-free 工程价值高，但视频编辑当下不是雷达核心；保存为长尾。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: Seeing Before Synthesizing: VLM-Guided Transition Event Discovery for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning
papers.abstract: Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning aims to localize and describe multiple events in untrimmed videos given only an ordered set of event-level captions per video. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.04183v1)：SBS（Seeing Before Synthesizing）针对弱监督 dense video captioning，把 LLM 合成的 transition caption 改为 VLM-guided 自适应过渡事件发现，避免无 grounding 的固定位置 caption。视觉-语言资产价值，长尾保留。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: Robust PAC Learning of Concurrent Stochastic Games
